title: Minimum Gaussian energy for parity requires exponential ReLU width
status: Conventional proof with two independent AI-agent mathematical reviews; not Lean formalized.
review_scope: Two independent agents checked the exact monotone Fourier extremum, sharp single-ReLU correlation and equality conditions, Gaussian energy lower bound, all relevant Fourier coefficients, exponential antipodal-orientation support requirement, degree-two exception, matching constructions at all larger widths, and polynomial-width bounded teacher. Both reviews identify the final source hash.
visual_check: Rendered pages 1 and 4 inspected: title, alphabetical author order and footnote, model, Fourier formulas and support lower bound; no clipping or malformed mathematics.

author_check.exact_footnote: Authors are listed in alphabetical order.
author_check.pdf_author_metadata: ChatGPT-6 Astra; Kaarel Hanni; Dmitry Vaintrob

critical_scope: Full Boolean cube, one hidden ReLU layer, appended constant input, linear readout, unchanged isotropic Gaussian coefficients within each layer.
For even parity degree r>=4, exact minimum energy E*=sqrt(d)/rho_r is attained if and only if N>=2^(r-1); degree two requires four neurons.
At every smaller feasible width the attained minimum energy is strictly greater, without a quantitative approximation-gap claim.
The same target has bounded-weight shallow teacher width O(r^2) and Boolean circuit size O(r).
No online mistake, sample-complexity, or approximate-energy width lower bound is asserted.
Floating-point optimization experiments are not used in the proof.
